ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: p2pchat uses Bluetooth to find nearby phones and pass messages without the internet. This can use more battery, and nearby radio scanners can detect Bluetooth activity. The app does not use GPS.
ios.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Bluetooth advertising lets nearby phones find this device and relay messages. Nearby radio scanners can detect this activity, and Bluetooth use can increase battery use.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: p2pchat uses the local network to exchange messages directly with nearby devices.
